alt: Three pairs of major salivary glands (Blausen). Parotid (largest, in front of ear, drains via Stensen's duct to opposite upper 2nd molar). Submandibular (under mandible, drains via Wharton's duct to floor of mouth). Sublingual (floor of mouth, multiple small ducts). Plus minor glands scattered throughout. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
